statement.text:
An element g of a (relatively) free group Fr (M) of rank r of a variety M is
said to be primitive if it can be included in a basis of Fr (M).
    a) Do there exist a group Fr (M) and a non-primitive element h ∈ Fr (M) such
that for some monomorphism α of Fr (M) the element α(h) is primitive?
    b) Do there exist a group Fr (M) and a non-primitive element h ∈ Fr (M) such
that for some n > r the element h is primitive in Fn (M)?          E. I. Timoshenko
